metadata.description: Claude Code skill for moving a Divi site to a block theme

plugins.name: wp-divi-migration
plugins.description: Move a Divi site to a block theme and the block editor: inventory where Divi lives, read Divi's layout model into theme.json, convert et_pb_ modules to blocks through the Divi Migration plugin, which runs on the server with WP-CLI, carry over Theme Builder layouts, menus, widgets and child-theme functionality, and reach visual parity with the wp-design-to-block-theme capture and compare scripts. Requires wp-design-to-block-theme.
